reason: Chasing clients for documents is genuinely my biggest headache before every call deadline, so the idea lands. But I am not putting 900 EUR and my clients' files on a system built by someone doing this 10-12 hours a week on the side, with one client who has not even finished the pilot yet; my junior already does the WhatsApp chasing for a fraction of that.
objection: The founder has a day job and one unfinished client. In the week before a submission deadline I cannot wait for 'next working day' support, and a backup person named in a contract is not the same as a person I have met.
would_change_my_mind: A phone call with the Bihor consultant after the 60-day pilot confirming the documents actually came in faster, plus a setup price around 500-600 EUR so it is in line with what things cost here.
